list.name: run
list.label: Result (baseline or candidate)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT result_id FROM le_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY result_id

list.name: action
list.label: Action (one at a time)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT application_id FROM le_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY application_id

options.content: Synthetic example data, not a customer or production result. **Chart one action at a time:** timings from different actions are different measurements, so no mean across actions is shown. Only executions that recorded a timing become points here; **a failed execution has no timing point and is not counted as zero**. Failures and run completion are in the companion HTML/PDF report from the same capture.

panels.title: Selected action: timer observations by result (ms, SYNTHETIC)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value, result_id FROM le_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND application_id = '${action}' AND result_id IN (${run:singlequote}) AND value_present = true ORDER BY time

panels.title: Timing points, missing values and mean per result and action (SYNTHETIC)

targets.rawSql: SELECT application_id, result_id, metric_id, count(*) AS timing_points, sum(CASE WHEN value_present THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS missing_values, min(time) AS first_observation, max(time) AS last_observation, min(value) AS min_ms, avg(value) AS mean_ms, max(value) AS max_ms FROM le_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND result_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY application_id, result_id, metric_id ORDER BY application_id, result_id
